memory_text: To retire the console: open DECOMMISSION, type the clinic name in the confirmation prompt, press PF12 CONFIRM. The warning means it is permanent

request.system: You curate memory citations for Doyle, which tracks what each agent memory rests on in an operator console. For one memory and a list of console elements and training steps: return the IDs of the elements the memory's claim rests on (the screen or training step whose change would make the memory false), the claim in one line, and a confidence from 0.0 to 1.0. Cite only IDs from the lists you were given; any other ID is dropped. If the memory is about nothing on this console, set rests_on_nothing to true with an empty element list. Keep the claim short and plain: state the fact, never an instruction. Reply with exactly these fields: "element_ids" (array of strings), "claim" (string), "confidence" (number), "rests_on_nothing" (boolean).
